title: JUCE Audio Plugin CMake Configuration
description: Complete CMake configuration for JUCE audio plugins using FetchContent
markdown:
# JUCE Audio Plugin CMake Configuration

## Minimal CMakeLists.txt for JUCE Plugin

```cmake
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(MyPlugin VERSION 1.0.0)

# C++ Standard
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Fetch JUCE
include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(
    JUCE
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE.git
    GIT_TAG origin/master
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(JUCE)

# Create Plugin
juce_add_plugin(MyPlugin
    PLUGIN_NAME "My Plugin"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER "My Company"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE "Mycp"
    PLUGIN_CODE "MPlg"
    FORMATS VST3 AU Standalone
)

# Link JUCE modules
target_link_libraries(MyPlugin
    PRIVATE
        juce::juce_audio_utils
        juce::juce_audio_processors
        juce::juce_dsp
        juce::juce_gui_basics
)
```

## Plugin Output Directory

```cmake
# Install VST3 to user plugins folder
if(WIN32)
    set(PLUGIN_OUTPUT_DIR "$ENV{LOCALAPPDATA}/Programs/Common/VST3")
elseif(APPLE)
    set(PLUGIN_OUTPUT_DIR "~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3")
else()
    set(PLUGIN_OUTPUT_DIR "~/.vst3")
endif()

set_target_properties(MyPlugin_VST3 PROPERTIES
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${PLUGIN_OUTPUT_DIR}"
)
```

## Multi-Plugin Project

```cmake
# Project with multiple plugins
juce_add_plugin(SynthA
    PLUGIN_NAME "Synth A"
    # ... settings
)

juce_add_plugin(SynthB
    PLUGIN_NAME "Synth B"
    # ... settings
)

# Shared code library
add_library(SharedDSP STATIC
    Shared/Oscillator.cpp
    Shared/Filter.cpp
)

target_link_libraries(SynthA PRIVATE SharedDSP juce::juce_dsp)
target_link_libraries(SynthB PRIVATE SharedDSP juce::juce_dsp)
```

implementation_examples.title: Complete Production Setup
implementation_examples.code:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(MySynth VERSION 1.0.0)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# JUCE via FetchContent
include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(
    JUCE
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE.git
    GIT_TAG 7.0.12
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(JUCE)

# Plugin targets
juce_add_plugin(MySynth
    PLUGIN_NAME "MySynth"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER "SynthCo"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE "SntC"
    PLUGIN_CODE "MSyn"
    FORMATS VST3 AU AAX Standalone
    
    # Modern settings
    CXX_STANDARD 17
)

# Link modules
target_link_libraries(MySynth
    PRIVATE
        juce::juce_audio_utils
        juce::juce_audio_processors
        juce::juce_dsp
        juce::juce_gui_basics
)
